name: alakazam741_v9_top8_core
archetype: Alakazam 741 top-8 general core — explicit turn state machine + attack reservation
summary: Reproduces the shared top-8 core from the 793-game analysis: one turn state (SETUP/PRESSURE/RECOVER/LOCKED/ENDGAME) per MAIN decision, an explicit attack reservation with a pre-attack gate, and a dynamic turns_to_deckout vs turns_to_win deck model that also counts Dudunsparce/Sacred Ash returns. Same 60 cards as v8; no Boss's Orders and no opponent-card/deck-name matchup branches.
notes: Deck is byte-identical to alakazam741_v8 — this version isolates the LOGIC change only.
One turn state is selected per MAIN decision; no simultaneous boolean modes.
Attack reservation: the best >0-damage attack is reserved, only gated pre-attack actions that preserve it and improve the plan run above it, END is blocked while an attack is reserved.

Dynamic deck model replaces v8's fixed max(8, prizes+3) floor and the hand>=12/deck<=14 cap; optional draw is allowed only when it makes the current KO, secures the first backup, or keeps turns_to_deckout > turns_to_win.
Dudunsparce Run Away Draw never empties the board; the benched engine draws only when the dynamic model is safe and it improves the current damage or the next attacker.
Retreat only to reach a benched attacker; never retreat away from an attack-capable Alakazam.
Enhanced Hammer / Xerosic / Battle Cage / stadiums are gated on board state and on preserving the reserved attack, never on card-name matchup.
No Boss's Orders is present in the deck and no gust logic exists.
_DIAG is extended with per-decision state, attack-reservation, retreat, Dudunsparce, 0-damage-attack and attackable-END counters for post-hoc metric aggregation.
